conditions: Attribution required, easy to find (a Credits screen is fine; the FAQ names a "Credits" screen in settings as the usual place). Use the FAQ's format: "Frost Waltz Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com)" plus "Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License", linked to http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/. If the app edits the file (cuts it, crossfades the loop seam, changes it in some other way), the credit must say it was modified (CC BY 4.0 s.3(a)(1)(B); the FAQ says "You MUST make it clear in the credits which parts are yours"). Playing it in a loop and lowering the volume under narration are not edits to the file. Don't add DRM or extra terms that stop others using the file (s.2(a)(5)(C)); a public R2 bucket meets this. No region or Premium limits.
